He sat down and broke up with me. Out of the blue.

Despite that little outburst, I was devastated. We’d been together a year. Talked about marriage and buying a house. Things had been harder since my injury, but we were committed to supporting each other and loving one another.
He left and I called my parents and cried myself to sleep.

The next day I texted him that I was extremely sad. He wrote back conversationally and eventually he asked if he could stop by that evening after work. (Keep in mind this is literally the next day after the break up)

He showed up at my door with a bouquet of flowers and a love letter he had handwritten asking for my forgiveness and to take him back. He invited me to go to his therapist with him and that love conquers all.
We went to bed together after lots of hugging and crying. My heart was happy.
